# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

Perhaps these were made in the last task, if they are they all need to be copied over. If there are missing productions, then run the appropraite code to bring that part of the analysis up to speed. Go through the analysis note and update every plot with the most current plots for pp, pPb, and Pbp and for all kinematic selections mentioned in text. ## recalculation of track residuals
The track residuals should be recalculated for ALL instances a track residual file `OFFICIAL_R_WEIGHT_FILE_*` is shown in `OfficialWeightDictionary.sh`, i.e. for the nominal result case and each of the systematic variation cases. You can assume that the VZ weights and Z weights the proceede this step are ok. Complete this using todays date 20260412 in file names where appropriate. Complete this for the standard Z pT 0-10 10-20 20-40 40-500 binning spread and following the guidlines in "redefinition of track residuals". For the correction value histogram plots written at `MainAnalysis/20251211_ResidualCorrection/workspace/plots` make sure the max track pT value is set to 15 GeV now.

### muon-track systematic redefinition
We have been using trackMuDR=0.004 and isMuTagged=false here and there for the muon-track systematic variation. We now settle on isMuTagged=false as the official muon-track variation. Change the residual correction, energy extrapolation, and systematics runner scripts accordingly. Remove the trackMuDR files from the directory, and update the isMuTaggedFalse ones from now on.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
